text:
ellie: Quick design check: playground streaming UX. Main choices: inline Stop + hover Regenerate, separate regen in composer, or regen only after stop. Also need token counter behaviour and prompt library access. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/plays/streaming. Thoughts?

marco: Inline Stop + reveal Regenerate on hover is clean. Stop should be primary and keyboard accessible. :thumbsup:

rachel: A11y: use aria-live=polite for streaming chunks and make Stop reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space). Add `aria-describedby` hint: 'Stops generation; use Regenerate to retry.'

zane: Token counter: tiny persistent badge top-right that shows approximate tokens during stream (use ~ or - while streaming). Expand to exact count + estimated cost on hover. Avoid layout shifts.

ellie: Prompt library: prefer a right-side flyout (responsive to bottom sheet on narrow screens). Ctrl+K opens, Esc closes and returns focus to composer. Each saved prompt needs descriptive aria-labels.

marco: Copy nit: 'Interrupt' vs 'Stop' debate. I prefer 'Interrupt' for clarity; update tooltip to explain partial output is kept.

rachel: Telemetry: emit ui.playground.interrupt with model, tokens_at_interrupt, and warm_cache_possible. Also differentiate user vs error interrupts.

ui-bot: Reminder: proto due Tue 2026-04-05. Please attach a11y checklist and keyboard shortcut docs.

ellie: Thanks — I'll update the Figma and prototype inline cluster + collapsed token badge. Drop any objections by EOD tomorrow.
